column2: Please caption each photo in the album with the date and place.
column3: 請替相簿裡的每張照片加上日期與地點的標題。
column4: caption a photo (為照片加說明)
column5: cap 頭 (capital)：放在照片頭上的文字

column2: She gently caressed the sleeping kitten's soft fur.
column3: 她輕輕撫摸熟睡小貓柔軟的毛。
column4: caress her hair (撫摸她的頭髮)
column5: caress 像「卡雷死」：卡著手輕輕摸，愛撫

column2: The school will certify that you completed the swimming course.
column3: 學校將證明你已完成游泳課程。
column5: cert 確定 + ify 使 → 使確定是真的

column2: In the festival parade, the boy dressed as a hero will chariot a team of horses.
column3: 在節慶遊行中，打扮成英雄的男孩會駕馭一輛由馬拉的戰車。
column4: chariot a horse team (駕馭馬車)
column5: chariot 像「洽里歐」：洽談馬車，坐上戰車

column2: The little girl chuckled when the puppy tried to catch its own tail.
column3: 小狗想抓自己的尾巴，小女孩咯咯笑了起來。
column5: chuckle 像「掐可」：被搔癢時掐不住的輕笑
